descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Operations & Standards - Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices. - Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels. - Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards. - Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence. Guest Experience & Quality Assurance - Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements. - Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering. - Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs. Training & Leadership Development - Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy. - Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning. Human Resources & Leadership Oversight - Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel. - Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet. - Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership. - Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required. Financial Oversight - Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet. - Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end Food & Beverage operations. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in multi-site operational oversight. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Strategic, dynamic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office and industry-specific systems. - Strong understanding of HR protocols, labor regulations, and compliance standards. - Expert knowledge of F&B operations, beverage programming, and luxury hospitality standards. Professional Competencies - Strategic thinker with operational agility and strong business acumen. - Results-driven, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative. - Capable of working cross-functionally across corporate and shipboard teams. Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams. Your Impact - Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems. - Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet. - Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences. - Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. - Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration. - Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives. - Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms. - Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence. - Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations. - Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines. - Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies. - Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership. - Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms. Your Journey so far - Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must. - Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry. - Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous. - Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility. - Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms. - Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration. - Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry. - Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software). - Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills. - Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams. - International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations. - Willingness to travel extensively. Your Essentials - SWISS Resident or Visa Holder Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Culinary Leadership - Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy. - Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices. - Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs. - Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects. Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance - Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required. - Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels. - Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements. - Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols. - Oversee beverage order and loading coordination. Training & Leadership Development - Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs. - Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards. - Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions. Human Resources & Team Management - Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness. - Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing. - Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet. - Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership. Financial Oversight - Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management. - Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. - Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems. - Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations. - Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards. titleByLocale.it: Senior Project Manager - Investimenti nelle Infrastrutture (Caraibi)

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. title: Finance and Accounting Manager - New Investments

titleByLocale.en: Finance and Accounting Manager - New Investments
titleByLocale.it: Finanza and Accounting Manager - New Investments
titleByLocale.de: Finanzen and Accounting Manager - New Investments
titleByLocale.fr: Finance and Accounting Manager - New Investments

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments.

Your Impact

Financial Management & Reporting

- Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI

- Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI

- Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions

- Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies

New Investments & Business Evaluation

- Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities

Budgeting & Forecasting

- Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes

- Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets

- Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights

Cross-Functional Support

- Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments.

- Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications

- Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments

Process Improvement & Systems

- Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities

- Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed

- Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background

- 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments

- Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus

- Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting

- Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls

- Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset

- Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple stakeholders

- High attention to detail with the ability to see the big picture

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

Join MSC Cruises for an exciting internship focused on analytics, performance tracking, and insight generation across two strategic areas: Customer Journey and Our best Programme.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about data analysis, insights generation, and dashboard creation, with a strong interest in improving employee and guest experience through measurable impact.

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

You will support the development of structured analysis, and follow‑up mechanisms, working closely with Customer Journey and HR department. The role provides hands‑on exposure to both guest‑focused and employee‑focused analytics.

Your Impact

Customer journey:

- Support recurring Customer Journey analyses, including canvas‑based reviews, mid‑season ship‑by‑ship analyses, and committee deliverables.

- Contribute to ad‑hoc deep‑dive analyses on specific topics, guest segments, nationalities, or ships, based on business and management requests.

- Prepare data extractions, charts, tables, and first‑level analytical outputs using standardised templates.

- Maintain Customer Journey analysis trackers, ensuring proper documentation, version control, and monitoring of action plans.

- Support follow‑up analyses and updates after pilots, operational changes, or management feedback.

- Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and alignment across Customer Journey deliverables and reporting.

Our BEST programme:

- Support the development, maintenance, and tracking of KPI frameworks for the OUR BEST programme.

- Consolidate and analyse data from multiple sources, including employee engagement surveys, OUR BEST feedback, training NPS, and relevant guest indicators.

- Build, update, and maintain dashboards to monitor programme performance, engagement, and impact over time.

- Produce regular performance reports and structured executive summaries for leadership reviews.

- Ensure data consistency, accuracy, and reporting standards across all OUR BEST analytics outputs.

- Support the preparation of data visualisations and storytelling materials for senior stakeholders.

Your Journey so far

- Degree (or currently enrolled) in Business, Data Analytics, Hospitality, or a related field

- Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail

- Advanced Excel skills; knowledge of dashboarding tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau) is a plus

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate data into structured insights

- Fluent in English

Your Essentials

Preferred Skills

-
Basic understanding of guest satisfaction metrics and NPS

-
Basic understanding of employee engagement metrics

- Experience with data visualisation and reporting tools

- Interest in customer journey, guest experience, and service improvement

- Familiarity with survey data analysis and open‑comment analysis

What This Role Offers You:

- Hands-on experience in analytics, KPI development, and dashboarding

- Exposure to real business impact through data-driven decision-making

- Opportunity to work in a global, dynamic environment

Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

descriptionByLocale.it: Join our team as a CRM Director, where you will lead data-driven customer engagement programs and lifecycle marketing strategies. Leverage your expertise in CRM and marketing automation to drive commercial growth and enhance customer loyalty. Be part of a vibrant luxury brand redefining the cruise experience!
descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
